name: Dao Cuo de Chaoxi
source:
“First comes this endless night...Light, instead, is the intruder. Light is a form of violence. It leaves a person with nowhere to hide.”
Inverted Tides is a Furry Visual Novel about growing up, escapism, and shattered illusions.

In this meticulously calibrated society, you play as Felix, a gray wolf plagued by chronic insomnia. To escape the crushing weight of reality, you have reduced yourself to a detached "specter", turning a blind eye to all messages and invitations.

That is, until an unavoidable weekend camping trip forces you to reunite with your three best college friends (Rex the tiger, Sid the dragon, and Arthur the bear) after two years apart. What was supposed to be a healing journey of nostalgia quickly unravels, as time has changed everyone beyond recognition.

The nostalgic facade is torn away, and once-hidden cracks begin to spread wildly through the late autumn woods. When the long, suffocating night finally ebbs away, leaving you to face the bloodstained fragments on the ground, will you choose to once again pick up the weight of a shattered bond, or drive into the blinding sunlight toward the unknown?

[From [url=https://hazyo.itch.io/invertedtides]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“首先到来的是这无尽的黑夜……光，反而是入侵者。光是一种暴力。它让人无处可藏。”
《逆潮》是一部关于成长、逃避现实和破碎幻想的毛茸茸的视觉小说。

在这个精心校准的社会中，你扮演菲利克斯，一只饱受慢性失眠困扰的灰狼。为了逃避现实的重压，你把自己变成了一个超然的“幽灵”，对所有的信息和邀请都视而不见。

也就是说，直到一次不可避免的周末露营旅行迫使你与分开两年后的三个最好的大学朋友（老虎雷克斯、龙席德和熊亚瑟）重聚。原本应该是一次怀旧的治愈之旅很快就解开了，因为时间已经让每个人都变得面目全非。

怀旧的外观被撕毁，曾经隐藏的裂缝开始在深秋的树林中疯狂蔓延。当令人窒息的漫长黑夜终于退去，面对满地血迹斑斑的碎片，你会选择重新拾起破碎的羁绊，还是在刺眼的阳光下驶向未知？

[来自[url=https://hazyo.itch.io/invertedtides]Itch.io[/url]]
